local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local frame=0
local sampleFrame=nil
local held=false
local function aim(p)
 local t=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local origin=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,0))
 local f=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-origin
 local d=p-origin
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=math.atan2(f.z,math.sqrt(f.x*f.x+f.y*f.y))-math.atan2(d.z,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y))
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 local function units(a) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(a*5120+.5))) end
 return units(yaw*gain),units(pitch),math.abs(yaw)<.04 and math.abs(pitch)<.04
end
local points={{util.vector3(-890.28466796875,357.12738037109375,6582.0),util.vector3(-787.9590454101562,357.3546142578125,6612.0),util.vector3(-696.0276489257812,350.4856262207031,6612.0),util.vector3(-591.8425903320312,349.7661437988281,6582.0),util.vector3(-500.588623046875,349.245849609375,6542.0),util.vector3(-455.1022644042969,226.4388427734375,6524.0),util.vector3(-312.7582092285156,234.46560668945312,6524.0),util.vector3(-148.8165283203125,225.90914916992188,6524.0),util.vector3(34.22513198852539,219.29550170898438,6524.0),util.vector3(239.8719482421875,232.13084411621094,6542.0),util.vector3(378.542236328125,218.98948669433594,6542.0),util.vector3(639.7371215820312,207.68992614746094,6528.0),util.vector3(783.9336547851562,357.2578430175781,6542.0),util.vector3(841.5865478515625,470.322509765625,6542.0),util.vector3(701.3667602539062,468.6763000488281,6638.0),util.vector3(598.8443603515625,468.98773193359375,6696.0),util.vector3(503.3858642578125,464.7012939453125,6772.0),util.vector3(409.5508728027344,454.9111022949219,6848.0),util.vector3(336.9407958984375,512.000244140625,6862.0),util.vector3(348.4065856933594,587.0968017578125,6876.0),util.vector3(363.2339172363281,699.4852294921875,6876.0),util.vector3(371.6051330566406,848.4381713867188,6876.0),util.vector3(363.65081787109375,999.9108276367188,6876.0),util.vector3(357.77374267578125,1155.33056640625,6876.0),util.vector3(354.3487243652344,1305.717529296875,6876.0),util.vector3(350.02508544921875,1463.612548828125,6876.0),util.vector3(352.6960144042969,1622.1170654296875,6876.0)}}
local step=1
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frame=frame+1
 local foe=nil
 local distance=160
 for _,id in ipairs({{0x666a7,0x66a02,0x66a03,0x66a04,0x666da}}) do
  local o=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  if o and o:isValid() and not Actor.isDead(o) then
   local dist=(o.position-self.position):length()
   if dist<distance then distance=dist foe=o end
   if frame%30==0 then print('Joined sewer enemy '..id..' pos='..tostring(o.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(o).current) end
  end
 end
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if down and not held then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not down then sampleFrame=nil end
 held=down
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print('Adaptive camera settled') end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died along escort route')
 if frame==5 then print('Adaptive route ready') end
 if step<=#points then
  local d=points[step]-self.position
  if math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)<25 then
   print('Adaptive waypoint '..step..' reached '..tostring(self.position))
   step=step+1
  end
 end
 if step>#points then
  print('Adaptive route complete')
  print('Adaptive route aim x=0 y=0')
 else
  local p=points[step]
  local x,y
  if foe then x,y=aim(foe.position+util.vector3(0,0,35)) else x,y=aim(util.vector3(p.x,p.y,self.position.z+100)) end
  print(string.format('Adaptive route aim x=%d y=%d point=%d',x,y,step))
 end
 if frame%30==0 then
  print('Joined current cell '..self.cell.name)
  print('Adaptive Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
  for _,id in ipairs({{0x32a16,0x32a17,0x32a18}}) do
   local actor=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
   if actor and actor:isValid() then print('Adaptive escort '..id..' pos='..tostring(actor.position)) end
  end
 end
end}}}}
